description: This file contains internal test definitions, sample input generators, and OpInfo registrations for masked reduction and masking-related tensor operations in PyTorch's testing suite.

classes.name: OpInfo
classes.description: Structure that defines detailed information about a specific tensor operation, including support capabilities, sample input generator, and other metadata.

classes.name: ReductionOpInfo
classes.description: Subclass of OpInfo specialized for reduction operations, includes reduction-specific parameters like identity element, ref function, and additional skips and decorators.

classes.name: SampleInput
classes.description: Container for a sample tensor input used in testing, including input tensor, args, and kwargs.

classes.name: DecorateInfo
classes.description: Encapsulates test decoration information such as expected failures, skips, or custom tolerances.

methods.description: Generate sample inputs for softmax-like operations with various shapes and dimensions.

methods.name: _generate_masked_op_mask(input_shape, device, **kwargs)
methods.description: Generate various mask tensors with different broadcasting properties for testing masked operations.

methods.name: sample_inputs_masked_reduction(op_info, device, dtype, requires_grad, **kwargs)
methods.description: Generate sample inputs for masked reduction operations, including different mask tensors.

methods.name: sample_inputs_sparse_coo_masked_reduction( op_info, device, dtype, requires_grad, **kwargs )
methods.description: Generate sparse COO format inputs for masked reduction operations supporting sparse inputs.

methods.name: sample_inputs_sparse_csr_masked_reduction( op_info, device, dtype, requires_grad, **kwargs )
methods.description: Generate sparse CSR format inputs for masked reduction operations supporting sparse inputs.

methods.name: sample_inputs_masked_norm(op_info, device, dtype, requires_grad, **kwargs)
methods.description: Generate sample inputs for masked normalization operations.

methods.name: reference_masked_std_var( numpy_fn, )
methods.description: Construct a reference function for masked std/var calculations, adapting numpy functions with correction based on parameters.

methods.name: sample_inputs_masked_std_var(op_info, device, dtype, requires_grad, **kwargs)
methods.description: Generate sample inputs for masked std and var operations, supporting different masks and input shapes.

methods.description: Generate sample inputs for masked softmax, log_softmax, and softmin functions.

methods.description: Generate sample inputs for masked cumulative operations like cumsum and cumprod.

methods.description: Generate sample inputs for masked logaddexp operations supporting different tensor shapes.
